title: All-in yield decomposed into spread and implied base rate

coverage.note: Floating-rate debt-like positions where BOTH all_in_rate_pct and spread_bps are parsed. Implied base rate = all-in minus spread, fair-value weighted. No external rate series is used anywhere in this exhibit. 2019Q3, 2022Q1 are absent from the panel and are drawn as shaded breaks on a calendar-continuous axis; no value is interpolated across them.
coverage.sentence: Computed on 19,009 of 31,067 investment-panel rows (61.2% of the window panel). Floating-rate debt-like positions where BOTH all_in_rate_pct and spread_bps are parsed. Implied base rate = all-in minus spread, fair-value weighted. No external rate series is used anywhere in this exhibit. 2019Q3, 2022Q1 are absent from the panel and are drawn as shaded breaks on a calendar-continuous axis; no value is interpolated across them.

source: Source: author's calculations on the ARCC BDC panel built from SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings.

values.units: percent per annum; coverage in percent of the quarter's debt-book fair value
values.inference_label: INFERENCE, not measurement: the implied base rate falls from 2.33% in 2018Q3 to 0.80% in 2021Q4 and rises to 5.46% in 2023Q4, a shape consistent with the 2020 easing and the 2022-2023 tightening cycle. It is derived purely from the filings; no SOFR or LIBOR series is in this dataset.
